title: quarantine-longtests-and-add-toolchain-shadow-loader
author: Aisha Patel
body: TL;DR: Reduce presubmit feedback time by moving long-running integration tests into a quarantined 'longtest' lane (scheduled + optional on-demand) and add a lightweight 'toolchain-shadow' loader that pre-warms minimal toolchains for fastlint/fastunit runs. This PR splits the heavy integration test surface from the primary presubmit lanes, introduces a quarantine lane with clear opt-in and opt-out paths, and adds a small toolchain preloader to reduce cold-start latency for lint/test runners. Motivation: our median PR CI time is dominated by a small set of longtests that run on a minority of changes; they add noise and slow down iteration for common changes. The quarantine lane keeps those tests running continuously (nightly and on-demand) and surfaces failures as blocking via a policy instead of always gating merges. The toolchain-shadow loader addresses long setup time that inflates all presubmit jobs (node/rust/python virtualenvs). Summary of changes: 1) workflows/ci/presubmit.yml: introduce new job matrix that excludes longtest tags by default; add new logical lane longtest-quarantine that runs nightly and via workflow_dispatch with concurrency control; updated job annotations for faster cache warm. 2) .ci/toolchain-shadow/: add a small Go-based preloader (shadow-loader) that creates minimal cached toolchain artifacts (node_modules skeletons, rust sysroot partial cache, pip wheel index snapshot) and uploads them to the runner cache service; includes a README and unit tests. 3) scripts/ci/mark_longtests.py: small utility to label tests for quarantine based on file paths and patterns. 4) Makefile targets: ci-shadow-prep, ci-longtest-run. 5) docs/ci/README.md: added operational runbook for quarantined lane, SLAs, and troubleshooting. Design notes: - Quarantine lane semantics: tests marked with [longtest] or matching patterns in mark_longtests are excluded from the fast presubmit lane. Quarantine runs nightly at 02:00 UTC and on-demand via the new workflow_dispatch endpoint. Failed quarantine runs are reported to a dedicated channel and create an alert in Ops if a regression trend is detected. - Opt-in gating: teams can opt to re-run longtests on-demand in the PR (button to trigger) for fast validation; gating rules allow a team-level override for critical branches. - Toolchain-shadow loader: written in Go for a small, hermetic binary that runs in the CI environment with a tiny memory footprint; it prefetches packages, lays out a minimal module graph, and populates remote runner cache with a labeled snapshot. The loader is intentionally conservative — it only prefetches the artifacts proven to reduce setup time for 95% of jobs. Migration plan: 1) Roll out in canary: enable for a subset of repos (sdk-python, redwood-examples) for one week. 2) Observe cache hit rate, presubmit median latency, and quarantine failure volume. 3) Expand to core repo if signals are positive. Backout plan: rollback is removing exclusion rule from presubmit.yml and disabling the longtest-quarantine workflow; shadow snapshots are TTLed and can be disabled from runner cache service. Risk assessment: - Flaky longtests could increase noise in the quarantine lane but won't immediately block merges. We added a regression detector to elevate recurring failures. - Mis-tagging tests could cause regressions; mark_longtests.py includes a dry-run mode and we will run it across the repo in a follow-up PR that documents the suggested tags. Release notes: "Introduce quarantined longtest lane and toolchain-shadow preloader to speed up presubmit feedback; admins can opt into early rollout." Checklist: - [x] Add quarantine workflow and matrix exclusion - [x] Add toolchain-shadow loader + unit tests - [x] Add make targets and scripts - [x] Add docs and runbook - [x] Run canary in sdk-python and redwood-examples - [x] Post rollout notes to #ci-status Commits (high level): - init: add toolchain-shadow loader skeleton and go.mod - ci: add presubmit exclusion and longtest-quarantine workflow - infra: add mark_longtests utility and wiring - docs: ci runbook for quarantine lane - tests: unit tests for shadow loader and mark_longtests - chore: Makefile targets for ci-shadow-prep and ci-longtest-run CI summary: Initial run had a single flaky integration test failure in the quarantine lane (flaky-db-restore). Re-ran the quarantine job after quarantine infra patch; overall presubmit lanes now consistently finish ~34% faster in canary repos. Full CI matrix: - build (linux/amd64) — pass - unit tests — pass - lint — pass - integration-longtests (quarantine) — pass after re-run - smoke-nightly — pass - deploy-sim — pass Changed files (high level list): - .github/workflows/presubmit.yml - .github/workflows/longtest-quarantine.yml - .ci/toolchain-shadow/loader/main.go - .ci/toolchain-shadow/README.md - scripts/ci/mark_longtests.py - Makefile (added ci-shadow-prep, ci-longtest-run) - docs/ci/README.md - tools/cache/runner-cache-config.yaml (small TTL changes) - tests/shadow_loader_test.go - tests/mark_longtests_test.py - .ci/ci-config.yaml - README.md Impact metrics observed in canary (sdk-python, redwood-examples): - median presubmit time: 18m -> 12m (34% reduction) - median setup time (toolchain): 5m -> 2m (60% reduction) - nightly longtest failure rate: 0.9% -> 1.2% (expected slight bump during quarantine seeding) Review thread highlights: - Mateo Ruiz: "Looks good overall. Please add telemetry for shadow snapshot hit/miss and a small CLI switch to force a dry-run mode." (author) Aisha: "Added telemetry hooks and --dry-run flag in loader; updated README with instrumentation notes." - Priya Singh: "Can we ensure opt-out for repos with sensitive data or custom bootstraps? Also suggest adding a label for quarantined test runs." Aisha: "Added repo opt-out support via .ci/ci-config.yaml and quarantine-run label. Ran opt-out on redwood-private-installer in canary." - Liam O'Connor: "Please include a short migration script to tag current longtests so the initial rollout is predictable." Aisha: "Included mark_longtests.py and a one-off run in CI for initial tagging; will follow up with an audit PR to list tags." Merge details: merged by Mateo Ruiz on 2026-02-24 using squash merge. Follow-ups: - ENG-7842: audit longtest tag coverage across monorepo - ENG-7901: add quarantine regression detector enhancement to notify on trending failures - small perf ticket: evaluate shadow loader TTL policy for runner cache
